title: Made screen, quality, and failure boundaries explicit
points: Market-wide screens still use every relevant blocker internally for exclusion, while analyst context now receives only selected-ticker warnings and a bounded failure sample.
Failed lanes and deterministic screens now emit failed or blocked component boundaries instead of appearing to pass or disappearing from trace output.

ROIC, dividend-yield, and FCF-yield screens can hand their evidence-backed selected tickers to an explicitly requested filing or announcement explanation without adding a second structured compute owner.
Whole-plan Router corrective retries are classified as medium obstruction risk and covered by a forced collision evaluation.
Analyst quality-warning text is capped so corpus-wide diagnostics cannot crowd out the evidence used for the answer.
Admin health now separates explicitly disclosed partial filing coverage after a screen from a silent high-severity ticker drop.
